general.title: Is It Drift or Is It the Game? How to Tell Before You Open Your Controller
general.describe: Your character walks left on its own. Your camera slowly pans up. Before you reach for a screwdriver, stop: many of these symptoms are not stick drift at all. A game setting, a deadzone problem, or a second input device can look exactly like a broken stick. Checking in the right order saves you from opening a controller that was never faulty. Start outside the game Drift means the controller itself is sending movement when you are not touching the stick. So test the controller, not the game. general.title: WooCommerce without checkout: turning the cart into an enquiry basket
general.describe: Some catalogues should never end in a payment form. Industrial parts, made-to-order furniture, anything quoted per project: the visitor wants to assemble a list, send it over, and get a price back. WooCommerce already gives you the list-building part for free. What you replace is the ending. This is the process I use: keep the cart, replace checkout with an enquiry form, store the submission as an order in its own status, notify both sides, and give the admin a place to work the quote.
